warnings: Column table 'ขยายเสา' (S-07): one row per level per mark (§8) — C1 and C2 at three levels, Cx only from floor 2 to the roof beam (other cells '—').

Section sizes read as printed horizontal x vertical (C1 0.45x0.55 at the footing level, 0.35x0.45 above; C2 0.45x0.45 then 0.35x0.35; Cx 0.20x0.20): width_mm = horizontal, depth_mm = vertical dimension of the sketch.

Stirrup callouts are printed as 'N-RBxmm@s' (e.g. 3-RB9mm@0.15m): N is the number of tie sets drawn at each spacing (outer + inner ties, matching the sketches), recorded as stirrup.sets — a field not in §0.4/§6; added here and flagged so the next house can reuse it.
Concrete cover printed per cell: 0.09 m below floor 1 (in ground), 0.04 m above, 0.03 m for Cx.
